item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 8 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 8-Final #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 14 August 2026(Friday)

Light to moderate rains was observed over Zambales and Bataan for the past 3 hours. With this development all RAINFALL WARNING in these areas are now terminated.Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Tarlac(Mayantoc, San Jose, Bamban, Capas), Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca, Lubao, Sasmuan, Macabebe, Masantol), Bulacan(Hagonoy), Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Calatagan), Metro Manila(Manila, Navotas, Pasay) and Cavite(Cavite City, Noveleta, Rosario, Kawit) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate rains affecting Zambales(Palauig, Iba, Botolan) and Bataan(Morong, Bagac, Mariveles) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
